name: Hug Embassy
source:
One unpaid intern to fetch me some coffee and find us some customers to hug. No previous hugging experience required! 

[From [url=https://heiden.itch.io/hug-embassy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
招一名无薪实习生，帮我跑腿买咖啡，再给我们找些愿意接受拥抱的顾客。有无拥抱经验均可！

［摘自[url=https://heiden.itch.io/hug-embassy]itch.io[/url]］
